Strings.server_modules.title: Server modules
Strings.server_modules.summary: Bundled and independently installed modules on this server. Enablement, residency policy and package changes are prepared as frozen plans and submitted only after confirmation; restart effects are called out.
Strings.server_modules.read_only: This account has no server-module management permission, and the server refused every management action. Module state, dependencies and residency facts remain visible.
Strings.server_modules.waiting: Waiting to reconnect and verify the original operation…
Strings.server_modules.unsubmitted: Not submitted; review the original plan before retrying.
Strings.server_modules.recovery_mode: The server is in recovery mode. Business modules are stopped. Preview restoring the complete bundled set, then leave recovery mode and restart normally.
Strings.server_modules.package_versions: Installed versions for the selected module
Strings.server_modules.packages_unavailable: The server did not return module package installation facts.
Strings.server_modules.package_plan_ready: Package verified. Review the frozen plan, then confirm.
Strings.server_modules.package_installed_restart: Installed. Restart the server to verify the package operation.
Strings.server_modules.package_rolled_back: Rollback recorded. Restart the server to verify.
Strings.server_modules.store_refresh_none: No source has a refresh URI.
Strings.server_modules.consent_summary: Select a module and review one declared action and target. Until expiry, that module can run this action without another prompt. File write binds the exact content digest; file deletion, data backup/delete, package removal and credential rotation still require explicit confirmation. Updates or trust/policy changes invalidate the permission. Host administrators only.
Strings.server_modules.consent_target: Exact target declared by the module
Strings.server_modules.list.title: Module catalog
Strings.server_modules.list.check_hint: Checked modules become the target set for enable, disable and wake actions
Strings.server_modules.list.empty: The server did not return a module list.
Strings.server_modules.select_hint: Click a module to see its identity, runtime state, dependencies and previewable actions. Check several modules to change them as one set.
Strings.server_modules.detail.runtime_hint: A dormant module is still installed and enabled; it wakes on the next business request.
Strings.server_modules.detail.actions_hint: Every action prepares a frozen plan and submits only after confirmation. Blocked or unwired actions state their reason.
Strings.server_modules.residency.disabled: The module is disabled and has no load state.
Strings.server_modules.residency.unknown: The server did not report residency for this module.
Strings.server_modules.action.admission_unknown: The server did not return admission for this action.
Strings.server_modules.action.busy: Another operation is running; wait for it to finish.
Strings.server_modules.action.session_changed: The login changed; read the module facts again.
Strings.server_modules.action.select_first: Select a module on the left first.
Strings.server_modules.action.already_enabled: The selected modules are already enabled.
Strings.server_modules.action.already_disabled: The selected modules are already disabled.
Strings.server_modules.action.already_loaded: The selected modules are already loaded.
Strings.server_modules.action.read_only: This account has no management permission; these actions cannot be submitted.
Strings.server_modules.action.enable_hint: Prepare a frozen plan to enable the selected modules; it takes effect after a server restart.
Strings.server_modules.action.disable_hint: Prepare a disable plan; enabled dependents or unfinished work block submission.
Strings.server_modules.action.wake_hint: Prepare a wake plan; it does not install, enable or restart a module.
Strings.server_modules.action.sleep_hint: Try releasing memory; active connections or background work block it.
Strings.server_modules.action.policy_hint: Prepare a residency policy change; it takes effect after a server restart.
Strings.server_modules.policy_hint: Submitting writes the desired policy; the effective policy updates after a restart.
Strings.server_modules.plan.title: Change plan awaiting confirmation
Strings.server_modules.plan.hint: Review the target, diff and blockers, then submit the original plan. Expired or blocked plans cannot be submitted.
Strings.server_modules.operation.title: Recent operations
Strings.server_modules.health.title: Module health
Strings.server_modules.health.hint: A read-only check; it does not wake modules or change the enabled set.
Strings.server_modules.health.not_checked: Module health has not been checked.
Strings.server_modules.credentials.title: Administrator credentials
Strings.server_modules.credentials.hint: Privilege confirmation and standing background permissions share these credentials. They are used only for the submission and are not stored.
Strings.server_modules.privilege_hint: Load a plan ID to review the module, version, target and effects. Approval requires administrator credentials.
Strings.server_modules.packages_hint: Independently installed module packages. Bundled modules ship with the server and cannot be installed or removed here.
Strings.server_modules.package_versions_hint: Choose a version to roll back to; the active version cannot be a target.
Strings.server_modules.package_no_versions: No installed versions for this module.
Strings.server_modules.package_plan.title: Package plan awaiting confirmation
Strings.server_modules.package_plan.hint: Review the module, version, publisher, runtime and declared privileges before confirming.
Strings.server_modules.store_hint: Search and install module packages from accepted sources; source state and catalog revision are shown separately.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_forbidden: This account has no server-module management permission.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_configurat: Module enablement is controlled by deployment configuration and cannot be changed here.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_recovery_m: The server is in recovery mode; only restoring the module set is allowed.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_recovery_b: The module still has unfinished recovery work.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_active_wor: The module still has active connections or background work.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_policy_kee: The residency policy requires this module to stay loaded.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_resident_w: This module must remain resident. Background work stays tracked through completion or recovery confirmation.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_resident_d: Another loaded module depends on this module.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_pending_di: The module will be disabled after a restart.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_dependency: An enabled module depends on it; disable the dependents first.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_action_uns: The server does not support this action.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_not_found: The server does not have this module.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_state_unav: The server-module state could not be read.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_revision_c: Another operation changed the module configuration; read it again before previewing.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_plan_expir: The plan expired; prepare it again.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_server_mis: The plan belongs to another server.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_effective_: The operation finished, but the effective set does not match the plan.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_response_i: The server response does not match the plan.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_reference_: This session has no plan reference, so it cannot submit.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_operation_: The server interrupted the operation; verify the result.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_idempotenc: The same request was used for different content; prepare a new plan.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_privilege_: The privilege plan was not found.
The background permission request is incomplete or invalid.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_session_ch: The login changed; read the facts again.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_package_lo: The module package failed to load.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_package_so: The source has not been accepted.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_package_ri: The package does not match this platform.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_package_ho: The package requires an incompatible Host API.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_package_ac: Bundled modules do not expose independent package actions.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_packaging_: The module ships with the server and cannot be installed independently.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_package_in: The server has not enabled independent package installation.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_wake_overl: Too many wake requests; retry later.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_host_stopp: The server is stopping, so the module is temporarily unavailable.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_stream_cle: Stream cleanup failed, so the module stays loaded.
Strings.server_modules.problem.module_background: Background work failed; the module needs recovery.
